scientific_integrity: Exact singular-value formula proved by angular orthogonality and Gaussian moments; infinite limits follow from Poisson CLT, large deviations and a separate trace bulk-edge decomposition. Finite numerical checker is corroboration, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: One complex dimension; standard Gaussian Fock weight; a hard disk cutoff of the anti-holomorphic linear symbol; fixed positive Schatten exponents only. The Gaussian boundary-product profile is known for other disk Toeplitz constructions and is credited; priority of implicit general reductions remains a risk.
title: A bulk–edge Schatten transition for a disk-truncated Fock Hankel operator
